summary: No model or evaluator has been run against this library. No agreement figure, no per-case outcome and no failure list exist yet; they are recorded only from a real run, never estimated.
honesty_note: A model-agreement figure may be added only from a recorded run: model identity, prompt and rubric versions, the input hashes and the per-case outcome, with every observed disagreement written out. Nothing here is a human reading, and a future agreement number would still not make this library a human benchmark.

human_study.note: No independent readers have judged these cases. Task C39 authoring supplies teaching and regression material; a study that asks whether a rubric agrees with readers is separate optional research with its own consent, sample and recorded disagreements.
